title: Organizational chart: CIA Office of Special Activities (OSA)
description: Organization chart headed "Office of Special Activities" showing the Assistant Director for Special Activities, Deputy Assistant Director and Executive Officer, with a Special Assistant for Liaison, Security Staff and Programs Staff. Below are a Deputy for Technology (Advanced Projects, Engineering Analysis, Development and Contracts Divisions), a Support Division, and a Deputy for Field Activities (Intelligence, Communications, Operations and Materiel Divisions). Chapter 4 text (page 193) notes OSA controlled CIA overhead reconnaissance until 1974.
